div.head: VI Atr Lat 2
div.ab: K. Abbatibus namque necnon et abbatissis maximis ibidem predicabatur obsecrationibus, ut uitę proprię legis frena regularis inponerent collaque iugo Christi leuissimo omnimodis infatigabiliter humiliterque subponeręnt, et sedula instantia sagacitatisque studio intentissime monita sibimet subiectis salutaria actuumque exemplaria bonorum, nomina maiori[bu]s officiis equantes uel inplentes, studiosissime inpendere procurarent, eosdemque a sancte tramite religionis uel ab almi norma patris Benedicti per anfractus obliquos dextrorsum uel sinistrorsum nequaquam deuiare permitterent.
div.note: Latin paraphrase of VI Atr (early 11th c.; K = Cotton Claudius A III f. 30, perhaps by Archbishop Wulfstan), text in column K (Liebermann’s text; until October 2026 in column T). Liebermann gives no German translation for it: for the meaning see the matching Old English chapter of VI Atr above, which it paraphrases (Liebermann prints in small type the words that correspond exactly to the Old English).; T: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Liebermann’s Latin Paraphrase)”, now “∅ (moved to K)”)
